{{Top|leg}}
'''Medical Supervisor''' was a rank used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. On [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], [[Sena Pakkallo]] and [[Denno Yanglan|Yanglan]] both held the rank of Medical Supervisor.
